# 07 — FellowshipTracker Protocol Rewrite

## Summary (one-paragraph verdict)

`FellowshipTracker.cs` reads AC fellowship state by walking hardcoded `acclient.exe` memory (two static pointers + a hand-rolled `PackableHashData` hash-table crawl). **The web target has already reimplemented this entire subsystem end-to-end from protocol truth** — parse (`holtburger-protocol`) → state machine (`holtburger-world`, *not* `holtburger-session`) → wasm snapshot (`SessionHandle::player_fellowship()` / JS getter `playerFellowship`) → plus all six outbound fellowship actions as `SessionHandle` methods. **Every field the bot actually consumes is already tracked *and* exposed**, and the web side exposes strictly *more* (per-member vitals/mana/stamina, CP, luminance, departed members, locks, an update-type discriminator). This is the **cheapest island to port** in the whole migration: the rewrite is a thin C# adapter over an existing, richer API — no new Rust, no new protocol work.

---

## (a) Data-needs table

### What FellowshipTracker extracts from client memory

Static anchors (`FellowshipTracker.cs:45-46`): `0x0087150C` = `ClientFellowshipSystem**`, `0x00844C08` = local player IID. Fellowship pointer chain: `*0x0087150C → +0x10 → CFellowship*` (`GetFellowshipPtr`, `FellowshipTracker.cs:215-222`). Member list is a manual hash-table walk over `_buckets`/`_table_size`, chasing `_next` at `+0x34` (`RefreshIfNeeded`, `FellowshipTracker.cs:224-257`), capped at 9 members, cached 2000 ms.

| Field (bot-visible) | Current memory source | Protocol message that carries it | holtburger status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IsInFellowship` (`:74`) | `GetFellowshipPtr()!=0` (`0x871510C`→`+0x10`) | presence of `FellowshipFullUpdate` (0x02BE) / cleared by `FellowshipDisband` (0x02BF) | **tracked+exposed** — `playerFellowship()===null` (`lib.rs:33146`; `world.fellowship: Option`, `handlers/fellowship.rs:14,84`) |
| `MemberCount` (`:79`) | `+0x14 _currNum` | derived: hashtable header count in `FellowshipFullUpdateEventData.fellows` | **tracked+exposed** — `members.length` (`fellowship.rs:101`, `lib.rs:24556`) |
| `FellowshipName` (`:93`) | `+0x18` PStringBase | `FellowshipFullUpdateEventData.fellowship_name` (`events.rs:196,214`) | **tracked+exposed** — `.name` (`fellowship.rs:95`, `lib.rs:24544`) |
| `LeaderId` (`:107`) | `+0x1C _leader` | `.leader_guid` (`events.rs:197,220`) | **tracked+exposed** — `.leaderGuid` (`fellowship.rs:96`, `lib.rs:24546`) |
| `IsLeader` (`:121`) | `LeaderId == *0x00844C08` (self IID) | `.leader_guid == self.guid` | **tracked+exposed (derived)** — compare `.leaderGuid` to `window.getLocalPlayerGuid()` (used by k1 bot, `k1_drive_combat.cjs:220,244`; internal `world.player.guid`, `lib.rs:17287`) |
| `ShareXP` (`:164`) | `+0x20 _share_xp` | `.share_xp` (`events.rs:198,221`) | **tracked+exposed** — `.shareXp` (`fellowship.rs:97`, `lib.rs:24548`) |
| even-XP-split | `+0x24` offset defined (`:56`), **no C# accessor** | `.even_share` (`events.rs:199,222`) | **tracked+exposed** — `.evenShare` (`lib.rs:24550`) — *not consumed by bot* |
| `IsOpen` (`:136`) | `+0x28 _open_fellow` | `.open` (`events.rs:200,223`) | **tracked+exposed** — `.open` (`lib.rs:24552`) |
| `IsLocked` (`:150`) | `+0x2C _locked` | `.is_locked` (`events.rs:201,224`) | **tracked+exposed** — `.isLocked` (`lib.rs:24554`) |
| member GUID (`GetMemberId`, `:207`) | hash entry `+0x00 _key` | `FellowshipMemberData.guid` (`events.rs:23,49`) | **tracked+exposed** — `member.guid` (`fellowship.rs:9`, `lib.rs:24456`) |
| member name (`GetMemberName`/`GetMemberNames`, `:193,199`) | hash entry `+0x08` PString | `.name` (`events.rs:34,62`) | **tracked+exposed** — `member.name` (`lib.rs:24458`) |
| member level | `+0x0C` offset defined (`:63`), **never read** by `RefreshIfNeeded` | `.level` (`events.rs:26,52`) | **parsed+tracked+exposed, unused by bot** — `member.level` (`lib.rs:24460`) |
| member share_loot / max_health / max_mana / current_health | offsets documented in struct comment (`:36-39`), **never read** | `.share_loot`/`.max_health`/`.max_mana`/`.current_health` (`events.rs:30-33`) | **tracked+exposed, unused by bot** (`lib.rs:24465-24478`) |

**Web-only extras with no memory-tracker equivalent** (available for free, never read by RynthAi today): `cached_cp`, `cached_luminance`, `max_stamina`/`current_stamina`, `max_mana`/`current_mana` fully, `departed_members` (guid+timestamp+cached name), `fellowship_locks`, and the `updateType` diff discriminator (`events.rs:22-35,99-103,193-204`; `lib.rs:24373-24387,24605`).

**Status-category rollup:** every consumed field is **tracked+exposed**. Nothing the bot needs falls into *tracked-not-exposed*, *parsed-not-tracked*, or *unparsed*. Precision the task asked for: **`holtburger-session` tracks *nothing* fellowship-specific** (`rg -i fellow crates/holtburger-session` → zero hits) — the session crate only decodes/routes generic `GameEventMessage`s; the fellowship **state machine lives entirely in `holtburger-world`** (`state/fellowship.rs`, `handlers/fellowship.rs`), which is compiled into the wasm.

## (b) Rewrite design for the web target

**Approach: drop-in C# adapter over `playerFellowship()` — zero consumer edits.** Because 100% of consumers call the `FellowshipTracker` public surface (not raw memory) and 100% of client access already flows through `RynthCoreHost`, keep the class name/API and reimplement its body to read a host-provided snapshot.

1. **Host-seam DTO.** Add one poll-style method to the `RynthCoreHost` contract, e.g. `bool TryGetFellowship(out FellowshipDto dto)` returning `{ name, leaderGuid, shareXp, evenShare, open, isLocked, FellowMember[] members(guid,name,level,curHp,maxHp,...) }`. The web host impl fills it from the already-exposed `SessionHandle::player_fellowship()` getter (`lib.rs:33146`) — **no new Rust required**; the Rust/wasm/JS side of this subsystem is complete (`FellowshipSnapshotJs` getters `lib.rs:24542-24607`; publish helper `lib.rs:36125-36207`).
2. **Self-GUID.** `IsLeader`/`IsMember(self)` need the local player id (was `*0x00844C08`). Source it from `window.getLocalPlayerGuid()` (`k1_drive_combat.cjs:220`) / `world.player.guid`, surfaced through the same host as `TryGetPlayerGuid`. Then `IsLeader = leaderGuid == selfGuid`.
3. **C# `FellowshipTracker` shim.** Replace `Marshal.Read*`/`GetFellowshipPtr`/`RefreshIfNeeded` with a call to `TryGetFellowship` into a cached struct. **Keep the existing 2000 ms cache** (`REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS`, `:68`) — it already models poll-with-staleness, which maps cleanly onto the host tick. All getters (`MemberCount`, `FellowshipName`, `LeaderId`, `IsOpen/Locked`, `ShareXP`, `IsMember`, `GetMemberName/Id`, `GetMemberNames`) become dictionary/list reads over the cached DTO. Member cap of 9 (`:240`) is unnecessary (protocol is authoritative) but harmless to keep.
4. **Poll-vs-async fit (low risk here).** The web refresh is event-driven: `WorldEvent::FellowshipStateUpdated` → recv-loop republishes `latest_fellowship` → signals JS via `kind=22 FellowshipUpdated` (`CLIENT_EVENT_KIND_FELLOWSHIP_UPDATED=22`, `lib.rs:21030`, doc `:21022-21030`). The C# side never blocks — it just reads its cached DTO each synchronous tick. This is the *benign* end of the poll-vs-async spectrum: fellowship is low-frequency, snapshot-shaped, and already latched on the wasm side.
5. **Bonus — outbound actions.** VTank AutoFellow historically drove recruit via chat macro (`/ub fellow recruit`, per `ExpressionEngine.cs:3039`). The web exposes typed actions: `fellowshipCreate/Quit/Dismiss/Recruit/UpdateRequest/AssignNewLeader` (`lib.rs:33053-33130`, opcodes 0x00A2–0x00A6/0x0290 `opcodes.rs:623-633`). The port can wire these directly if `RynthCoreHost` gains matching action calls — a strict upgrade over chat injection, though not required to reach parity.

**Known-unportable status:** the 508-line "unportable island" count for this file **collapses to ~0** — the acclient addresses/offsets are fully replaced by an already-implemented protocol path; only a small C# adapter + one host-contract method remain.

## (c) Estimated effort

**LOW — ~0.5–1.5 engineer-days.** Breakdown:
- C# `FellowshipTracker` body rewrite (~120–150 LOC of the 272; pure logic, no consumer changes): **~0.5 day**.
- `RynthCoreHost` contract: one `TryGetFellowship` DTO method + one `TryGetPlayerGuid` + web-host marshaling from the existing `playerFellowship()`/`getLocalPlayerGuid()`: **~0.5 day** (bounded by the host-seam ABI/marshaling pattern, not by fellowship logic).
- Rust/wasm/protocol work: **0** — complete and richer than needed.
- Optional outbound actions (recruit/quit/dismiss/assign) if AutoFellow write-path is in scope: **+0.5 day**.

**Ranking:** this is the *lowest-risk, lowest-cost* of the named unportable islands — the web team pre-built the whole fellowship stack (roster panel HUD work, recs #48/#103), so the migration is adapter-only.
